limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The novelty claim is restricted to the finite-field locally finite collapse of all higher-arity multilinear basic operations and its exact zero-product/unital consequences. The result is a short specialization of arXiv:2609.19651v1. Burgin (1974) is the closest older source and treats homogeneous identities over commutative rings and the infinite-field classification; differently phrased finite-field prior coverage remains possible.
record_title: Locally finite Schreier multilinear algebras collapse over finite fields
